text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, invited by Mejiro Dober, I came 
to an event to make a room fragrance 
called "moist potpourri."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For her, an herb lover, I must give my 
full support so we can make something 
delightfully aromatic...!"
choice_data_list: Now, which herbs should we pick?
Now, which herbs should we pick?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...No, really, it's not the kind of event 
to get that fired up over."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, calm down, Trainer. It's fine, you 
don't have to push yourself so hard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, we've walked quite a 
bit... I want to take a short break. You 
sit down too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We've walked pretty far to get here, so 
you must be tired, right? I brought some 
herbal tea, so let's take a break.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...There's chocolate and stuff, so why 
don't you have some? It'd be a problem if 
you ran out of steam halfway through.
choice_data_list: But what about the event?
But what about the event?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I brought lots of chocolate and stuff too! 
We're gonna be moving around, so we need 
the sugar, right?
choice_data_list: But what about the event?
But what about the event?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The event goes on until the evening. Come 
on, hurry up and get into the shade over 
there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's open until evening, so no worries! 
Come on, let's rest in the shade over 
there. Over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Giving in to Mejiro Dober's 
uncharacteristically persistent urging, I 
received her gentle care. And then, once 
we set out to gather herbs—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Giving in to Mejiro Dober's 
uncharacteristically persistent urging, I 
received her gentle care. And then, once 
we set out to gather herbs—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, there's rosemary over there...
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we pick that one?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"No, I'm not so sure. It might feel 
refreshing and motivating, but it could 
also make you feel like you need to do 
even more."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"That would defeat the whole purpose, 
wouldn't it? Maybe I should go with 
another herb after all..."
choice_data_list: Hello?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-It's really nothing! Let's put this on 
hold for now. Let's look over there 
instead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah... n-never mind. Let's hold off on the 
rosemary for now. Let's check over there 
too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If I climb this cliff, that herb is sure 
to be there...!
choice_data_list: Cl-Climb this cliff?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Because I need 'Munya'! That herb that 
grows high in the mountains...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It has a relaxing effect and is good for 
your health, too!
choice_data_list:
If you get injured, your health will be in 
serious trouble...!

If you get injured, your health will be in 
serious trouble...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as she claimed it wasn't an event to 
get worked up over, I felt a sense of 
incongruity at her frantic demeanor as I 
kept accompanying her to gather herbs...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I got word that the 
"moist potpourri" was finished. I wondered 
if she'd come show me the result, and sure 
enough...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. The 'Moist Potpourri' from before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The moist potpourri I made the other 
day!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What, you won't accept it? I can... vouch 
for the quality, at least.
choice_data_list: What!? I-Isn't this yours...
What!? I-Isn't this yours...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? You're not going to take it? It 
smells so good, and I was actually a 
little confident in how it turned out...
choice_data_list: What!? I-Isn't this yours...
What!? I-Isn't this yours...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Nah, I've already got a few of them, so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did I say something like that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... a little while ago, I got a call 
from the chief trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, you see, a little while ago, 
I got a call from the chief trainer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um, it's been a while! Is something the 
matter...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um, it's been a while! Is something the 
matter...?

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"I was just wondering how you've been 
doing lately. You're not pushing yourself 
too hard, are you? Are you making sure to 
get enough rest?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I'm enjoying it thoroughly! 
Having tea parties with everyone in the 
Mejiro family and all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm truly fine... At least, on my end.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text: ""? Belle-chan...?""

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! It's really nothing. I'm totally 
fine, so...!

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text: "I see... Can I ask one thing?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Belle is a kind girl who cares about 
others far more than you might think."

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"‘So, have more confidence in your 
kindness. If you do, everything is bound 
to work out.’"

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. Do your best, I'm rooting for you!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
! ...Y-Yes! Thank you for calling. 
Goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...You're always worrying about me, 
aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, you're always looking out for 
me, like telling me to get some rest and 
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I just couldn't bear to watch it, 
you know...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So... I wanted to return a little bit of 
that thoughtfulness myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even though she told me not to push 
myself while gathering herbs, the reason 
she worked so desperately... was out of 
pure concern for me."
choice_data_list: Thank you, for my sake.
Thank you, for doing this for me.

text_block_list.text:
"Even though she told me not to push 
myself while gathering herbs, the reason 
she worked so desperately... was out of 
pure concern for me."
choice_data_list: Thank you, for my sake.
Thank you, for doing this for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
!? I-It's not like I did it for you or 
anything! I just didn't want to let their 
expectations down!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"No, thank YOU. I'm always so grateful for 
how much you cherish me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Besides... if we're not both in top shape, 
we won't even win races we should, right?
choice_data_list:
Let's keep doing our best together from 
now on.

Let's keep doing our best together from 
now on.

This time, it's my turn to take care of 
you.

you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So... I'm glad you liked it. That means I 
managed to give a little something back 
for everything you do for me.
choice_data_list:
Let's keep doing our best together from 
now on.

Let's keep doing our best together from 
now on.

This time, it's my turn to take care of 
you.

This time, it's my turn to take care of 
you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Since I went through the trouble of 
making it, I expect you to work hard 
enough to make up for it."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I've got high hopes for you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't slack off just because it smells 
good, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
First, let's both do our best in 
tomorrow's training, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, if we start counting 
that, we'll never stop, right?
choice_data_list: This isn't the end of us, is it?
This isn't the end of us, is it?

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, if we start counting 
that, we'll never stop, right?
choice_data_list: This isn't the end of us, is it?
This isn't the end of us, is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on a second... Um, what... do you 
mean by that...?"
choice_data_list:
As your Trainer, I'll be with you every 
step of the way, giving it my all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*... Don't phrase it in such a 
shocking way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Aaah!! Geez, after all this time? 
Isn't that what you always do for me 
anyway!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if you insist on returning the 
favor, go right ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...You surprised me. I totally 
thought..."
